title: Direct assessment of ionic liquid fragility from transport property variation at moderate temperatures
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27085-27089
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03960J, Paper
Open Access

Adhip Rahman, Shayanta Chowdhury, Md. Abu Bin Hasan Susan
An approach to assess the ionic liquid (IL) dynamic fragility is discussed in this work; for this, viscosity data (a transport property) of 48 ILs of different classes (aprotic, protic, surfactant and magnetic) were surveyed.
